summary: PIM Manager shows your own environment name everywhere, and new installations give support read-only access.

new.title: Your environment name shows everywhere
new.text: PIM Manager shows the environment name you keep in Invardia in mail subjects, exports, the environment report, the header and the browser tab.

fixes.title: Support access is read-only by default
fixes.text: A new installation gives Invardia support read-only database access, with admin rights only during an open support session.
